text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I was reading up on so many things that 
before I knew it, dawn had broken. 
I just couldn't stop thinking about what 
Ramonu-senpai said.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I did the exact same thing. 
And... it wasn't just about the meaning of 
"love" or "romance" either.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...She asked me if racing was truly the 
only way to achieve my dream. 
To be honest, that was what stuck with me 
the most...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
To bridge toward the future, to guide 
others. True, regardless of the 
field—anyone who nurtures the next 
generation shares that exact same 
ambition. ...It's something you could do 
anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
.........I understand. 
That hit home for me a bit, too...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like we're both a little stuck, 
aren't we? 
—...*Sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Cesario & Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I want to run. 
I really want to run, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—Hehe. ...I have a suggestion. 
How about we do some early-morning 
training together to clear our heads?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—15 seconds. 
Just as expected, your internal clock is 
perfectly calibrated.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, repetition really is key after all. 
When there was a period I couldn't run for 
a while, it was terribly off the first 
time I timed it again.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... If only there were an effective 
training method to maintain that internal 
clock outside of running—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
*Pant*, *pant*... Phew... Doing hill 
climbs repeatedly really does build up 
lactic acid, after all...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Speaking of lactic acid, I was recently 
thinking about graphing performance levels 
using blood lactate levels as an 
indicator—

text_block_list.name: Cesario & Messiah
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
*Pant*, *pant*... 
—Oh. Before we knew it, the sun...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It's already almost 7:00. 
I completely lost track of time.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, we really got into it, didn't we? 
Maybe we both just love racing a little 
too much.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly... ———— 
...We really do love racing, don't we...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ah... —Right.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...I really love it, don't I? 
Just as if—I were truly "in love" with 
someone from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
My mother was certainly the catalyst. But— 
No one forced me into this. I was drawn to 
racing entirely of my own accord, with all 
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's the Umamusume who dream of the racing 
world that I hold so dear, and it's what 
the Tiara Umamusume have woven together 
that showed me my ideal.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It might be a little different from the 
kind of "love" Ramonu-san talks about, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—I love racing. It's gentle and quiet, 
but... right here inside me, there is a 
deep affection for racing itself.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...It is the same for me. My mother was my 
catalyst as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—However, it couldn't have been just 
anything. 
There is no way it didn't have to be 
racing.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The sight of my mother, running with 
everything on the line in her races, was 
what I found truly sublime and beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—It is neither yearning nor madness. 
This profound reverence—is my love for 
racing.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, Cesario! Messiah-san too! 
Were you doing morning training?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—! Look who's here, Craft. 
Could you be with Heart-san?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. We came out thinking we'd get some 
training in, but... 
we gained something quite unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We saw Ramonu-san running! 
And then—I understood! What Ramonu-san 
meant by her words!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Seems like we're on the same 
wavelength. 
Hey, everyone. There's something I want to 
make sure of—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—Ramonu-san! 
Would you please run with us one more 
time?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —And why is that?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
There's something I want to test. I feel 
like I've finally found the answer I've 
been searching for—and I want to be 
certain.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu-san. By running with you, I know I 
will find that conviction. 
—I swear I will not run half-heartedly. So 
please.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Very well. 1800m on turf—let's make it a 
mock race.

text_block_list.name: Gallery
text_block_list.text:
No way, Ramonu-san's doing a mock race? 
Her opponents are Cesario-san and the 
others. Whoa, they've got guts...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You there. Would you time us, please?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Ah, yes...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: A-All right then... 1800m on turf—start!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(Not a single opening—a start beyond 
flawless.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(She's seized complete control of the pace 
right from the get-go. 
And—the sheer intimidation radiating from 
her back...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(It's like she has eyes in the back of her 
head. The moment I try to make a move, she 
counters and shuts me down immediately. 
Under such suffocating pressure—my legs 
freeze.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Just like at the training camp. 
Confronted with an overwhelming gap in 
ability and crushed to pieces—that vivid 
sense of despair comes rushing back.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Still!

text_block_list.name: Cesario and Co.
text_block_list.text: There's no way I'm giving up...!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario and Co.
text_block_list.text:
—I love racing. I want to stake everything 
on these legs and prove it. 
I want to etch my run into this turf. I 
can never forget the joy of that moment.

text_block_list.name: Cesario and Co.
text_block_list.text: I want to reach the goal that I love—!

text_block_list.name: Cesario and Co.
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ――Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes――what a wonderful color.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Petite fleur…… freshly sprouted fighting 
spirits. 
Just like a sweet first love――not bad at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Haaah――!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: G-Goal! In 1st place, Mejiro Ramonu-san……!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Urrrgh, she's still so far ahead……! 
Just feelings alone…… aren't enough to 
reach her――)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
――It was a lovely color. 
Keep working hard in this manner.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ……U-Um…… I took everyone's times, but……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah…… yes, thank you! Sorry for putting it 
on you so suddenly―― 
…………Oh. Seriously?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Heart-san, is something the―― oh…… 
…………Personal best.

text_block_list.name: Craft & Messiah
text_block_list.text:
――M-Me too…… 
……Same here.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: …………Could this be the power of love?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Pfft――Ahahahahahaha! Yes, maybe it is! 
It must be the power of love! Fufu, 
fufufu!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ――Love is what makes us stronger!
